verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Moneybird exposing its own API as an MCP server that external clients like Claude or ChatGPT connect to. That is the server role, and it does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Moneybird letting users plug in external MCP servers so the product can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
